claims.statement: MXJO 18650 20A 3000mAh is documented as an unprotected flat-top cell of approximately 18.2 mm x 64.9 mm; MXJO also describes a scratch authentication code, MXJO top marking, and anti-counterfeiting mark.
Steam Engine preserves MXJO IMR 18650 20A 3000mAh 20A as a 3000mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.

The MXJO IMR 18650 20A catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for MXJO IMR 18650 20A in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
